name: inaro
description: INARO — Empathetic AI Companion for Mental Well-Being

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server" --names "CLIENT,SERVER" --prefix-colors "cyan,green"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev:ai" --names "CLIENT,SERVER,AI" --prefix-colors "cyan,green,magenta"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
